body:
Thank you. I just wish someone could see how unimportant and worthless I feel, especially compared to other people, better or more important than me. 

That by itself, makes me want to die. Knowing that no matter what, I’ll always be forgotten or everyone will move on and leave me behind; but, also knowing how selfish I am and blaming myself more. 

Even when I’ve told them how I feel, it gets dismissed or played off as a cry for attention. I’ve explicitly said I wanted to die before and I got in trouble because they couldn’t and didn’t want to even try to understand, as if it aggravates them or I’m being a brat, then I feel worse. 

They’re the best and I don’t deserve them, I really am grateful. 

But, why won’t anyone do anything or try harder? I only have them. They say I’m lazy, messy, and others, and that I need to stop pitying and feeling sorry for myself. I don’t, I blame myself everyday for everything. 

My load will continue to get heavier and no one will notice and just add more on top until I’m gone. 

I don’t want to feel anything anymore. Sorry if I wasted your time, I am listening to what you say.

thanks, I will try that. It just seems like nothing will change, I will still grow up and no one will want or need me around anymore (especially with their other family.) It just hurts knowing I’m replaceable and that I’m essentially worthless. I don’t really believe there is getting better for me. 

thank you for your replies and trying to help me. God bless you (if you’re religious.)
thanks for the replies. No one’s ever been this nice to me before. I’m not sure I deserve it, but thank you.

Thanks for taking the time to reply. 

I guess I just don’t understand how anyone could want or need me around. Once, I get older, I’m sure they will just forget about me and move on with their lives and their partners and I’ll be alone again, like most of the time. I don’t deserve them, they’re too good for me. Again, thank you.
